name: CDC Hume 3 (HU3)

address.value: 54 Sheppard Street, Hume ACT 2620 (Block 31 Section 3 Hume)
address.note: PeeringDB lists HU1, HU2 and HU3 (Hume Campus One) at 54 Sheppard St; ACT cadastre gives 54 Sheppard St = Block 31 Sec 3 Hume, 8,198 sqm (source 5). HU3 may instead or also occupy adjacent Block 18 Sec 3 (56 Sheppard St, 4,805 sqm), where Whereis lists Canberra Data Centres Pty Ltd and which shares 2015 lease-variation DA 201528083 with Block 31 (source 5)

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '54 Sheppard Street, Hume ACT 2620' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). PeeringDB campus point is -35.388831, 149.1683 (about 45 m away).

builder.note: not found. Lead only: C&H Group subcontractor page 'Data Centre' (Canberra) names builder Hindmarsh Construction Australia, scope 'Building 3 New Partitions, Ceilings, Glazing...' ($1.6M); unclear whether 'Building 3' means HU3 (source 6)

mw_it.note: Infratil investor briefing 19 May 2016: 'CDC's fourth data centre (Hume 3, 9 MW) currently under construction'; also '27MW greenfield development pipeline including a 9MW facility under construction and due to be completed in mid-2016'. Not stated whether IT or total; treated as IT capacity. CDC lists Hume Campus One (HU1+HU2+HU3) at 21 MW (source 2). datacenterslist.com gives an 'AI estimate' of 3.292 MW (not used).

pathway.value: Development application (ACT Planning and Development Act 2007)

reference.note: not confirmed. Candidates in the ACT completed-DA register (source 5): DA 201426501 on Block 31 Sec 3 (subclasses commercial, demolition, design and siting, industrial; lodged 2014-11-13, approved conditional 2015-02-13); DA 201527799 on Block 18 Sec 3 (demolition, design and siting, industrial; lodged 2015-05-25, approved conditional 2015-07-08); DA 201528083 on Blocks 18 and 31 Sec 3 (lease variation, clause changes; lodged 2015-07-30, approved conditional 2015-10-09). Timing of all three fits 'HU3 construction commences' 2015; proposal text not retrieved

construction_start.note: CDC About us timeline: '2015 HU3 construction commences'

construction_end.note: CDC About us timeline: '2016 Construction of HU3 completed'; Infratil May 2016 said 'due for completion in mid-2016' (source 3)
